product.title: Cortech BevMax Beverage Dispenser - BMX5
product.body_html:
The Cortech BevMax Beverage Dispenser is one of the toughest and most durable bulk beverage dispensers available today. The BevMax Dispenser has a 5 gallon capacity, and is designed for maximum thermal retention. The one piece base design, provides an almost indestructible container. The lid and base combination can accommodate locks or tie wraps to provide a tamper resistant closure. The Cortech BevMax Beverage Dispenser also comes with molded in handles for easy transport, as well as having the ability to stack on one another. The material is made of an FDA approved high density polyethylene, and is manufactured according to ISO Quality Standards.

  • Five (5) Gallon Capacity.
  • Manufactured with FDA approved material.
  • Insulated for maximum temperature retention longer than traditional bulk beverage dispensers.
  • One piece seamless design housing and lid are both rotationally molded with virgin high density polyethylene.
  • Virtually indestructible.
  • No gasketing required.
  • Twist-on lockable lid can accommodate key / combination locks or tie wraps for tamper resistant closure.
  • Molded in handles for easier transport/lifting.
  • Stackable.
  • Heavy duty 2 way spigot.
  • Vented for smooth dispensing of liquids.
  • Accommodates most popular coffee cup sizes and 20 oz. tumblers.
  • Sanitary easy to clean and store.
  • Available colors: BMX5BN Brown, BMX5GY Grey, BMX5BK Black, BMX5GT Granite, and BMX5OR Orange.
  • Manufactured to ISO Quality Standards in the USA.

Applications: Corrections, Behavioral Health, Mental Health, Law Enforcement, Schools and Universities, Military, Intensive-Use Environments, Recreational Facilities

About Cortech USA by Correctional Technologies:
Cortech USA (Correctional Technologies) manufactures products that are exceptionally durable, designed for use in compassionate and normative behavioral healthcare, corrections, law enforcement, heavy use commercial and industrial environments, parks and recreation, schools, universities, hospitals, emergency and homeless shelters, and other institutions and facilities where safety and durability matter. Cortech products are ideal for extreme use and intensive use environments.
